description: This file defines FastAPI routes related to user authentication, including registration, login, and profile retrieval. It imports dependencies, defines route handlers, and interacts with services and database sessions.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class handling authentication logic such as registering users, authenticating credentials, and retrieving user data.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(AuthService)], )
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user with hashed password, returns user info, or raises conflict/validation exceptions.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(AuthService)], )
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT access token, raising unauthorized exception if invalid.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(AuthService)], )
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's profile data or raises an unauthorized error if user not found.
